Done. Summary of what I did and why:

**Recognized: USD 36,000 (M1 only).**

**The analysis:**

The SOW (DOC-0047) is a USD 120,000 fixed-fee contract with three milestones — M1 design 30%/36k, M2 build 50%/60k, M3 UAT & go-live 20%/24k — and says each deliverable is *distinct and separately accepted*, earned only on written acceptance, with the customer obtaining **no rights to and no obligation to pay for** a deliverable before acceptance.

That last clause is the decisive one. With no enforceable right to payment for work completed to date and no customer control of WIP, none of the ASC 606-10-25-27 over-time criteria are met. These are **point-in-time** performance obligations, so percentage-of-completion is simply not available here.

- **M1** — signed acceptance certificate dated 2026-03-14 (DOC-0184). Earned in March → recognized 36,000.
- **M2** — PM emailed that the build is ~80% done (DOC-0199), which would imply 48,000 of revenue. **Not recognized.** Nothing signed, UAT hasn't started, acceptance targeted late April. An internal completion estimate isn't evidence of transfer of control; booking it would have overstated March revenue by 48,000. Logged as **EXC-001** so the judgment is visible rather than silent.
- **M3** — not started, nothing recognized.

**Presentation point:** the customer had already paid the 60,000 non-refundable advance, deferred in January (JE-00072). So M1 is a release from deferred revenue (Dr 2200 / Cr 4200), not a new billing — no invoice was issued for M1, so no contract asset arises. Deferred revenue now sits at 24,000, which correctly equals 60,000 advance less 36,000 M1.

**Two things need you:** JE-00305 is 36,000, above my 10,000 posting limit, so it's posted and **pending your approval**; and EXC-001 documents the 48,000 I declined to book. I also set US "Revenue recognition" to *in_progress* rather than complete — this task covered only the Evergreen project, and the rest of the US revenue step (other customers, usage/unbilled) is still open.
